Sam (People Ops): quick heads-up — new promo/comp-change cycle timeline + a few process updates. Manager packet due 2026-04-14 EOD PT. Calibration week 2026-04-20 through 2026-04-24. New paybands published (see Maria's link below). pls read before you assemble packets :folded_hands:
Jen (Eng Manager): thanks! are transfers between teams treated as promos for comp purposes?
Sam (People Ops): short answer: sometimes. if title change + level bump -> treat as promotion. lateral transfers w/ no level change -> no comp adjustment unless approved via exception.
Alex (Finance): also note budget cap per org will apply. any midcycle increases that exceed org budget need director + finance signoff. we’ll run org-level deltas after packets are in.
Kevin (Recruiter): if a leveling change affects an active offer, do we update offer docs or do new approvals required?
Maria (People Ops): update offers — recruiter should ping people-ops once manager confirms. small increases (<5% and within band) can be updated without full approval, else use exception flow. doc: https://intranet/redwood/peopleops/paybands-2026 (internal)
Jen (Eng Manager): what's the process for retro pay? some of my ICs were performing at level for months.
Maria (People Ops): retro policy = effective date is promotion approval date unless manager requests retro to earlier date and payroll cutoffs permit. retro > 30 days needs HR + Finance signoff. payroll cutoff this cycle: 2026-04-10 for retro on April payroll.
Sam (People Ops): exception flow (for >5% or out-of-band): submit comp-exception form -> manager -> director -> people-ops -> finance. please include: justification, benchmark comps, impact to budget. sample payload: ```name, current_level, requested_level, current_base, requested_base, justification, requested_effective_date```
Alex (Finance): FYI we also need a short T-shirt-size estimate of org delta (small/med/large) when you submit packets so we can prioritize forecasting.
Kevin (Recruiter): for internal offers that change leveling, is there a preferred template?
Maria (People Ops): use the internal offer template v3 (shared drive). recruiters: include old vs new total comp line and note any sign-on or one-time adjustments.
HR Bot: [automated] Promo packet template v3 uploaded by Maria (People Ops) — https://intranet/redwood/peopleops/promo-template-v3
Jen (Eng Manager): thanks — one edge case: manager wants to split promotion into title-only now and comp bump next quarter. allowed?
Sam (People Ops): allowed but discouraged. We prefer concurrent title + comp changes. If splitting, document rationale in packet and pass through exception flow so finance knows timing.
Maria (People Ops): we'll host a 30-min Q&A tomorrow 10am PT to walk through the packet + calibration rubric. calendar invite out now.
Sam (People Ops): cool — ping me or Maria in DM for odd cases. if you need the packet checklist: attach job summaries, manager calibration notes, comp rationale, peer calibration notes. :rocket:
